channel.title: FRB: Press Releases
channel.description: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System press releases

item.title: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with United Texas Bank
item.description: The Federal Reserve Board on Friday announced the termination of enforcement actions with United Texas Bank, Dallas, Texas.

item.title: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of Banco Popular de Puerto Rico
item.description: The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday issued an enforcement action with a former employee of Banco Popular de Puerto Rico.

item.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on July 20 and July 29, 2026
item.description: The Federal Reserve Board on Tuesday released the minutes of its discount rate meetings from July 20 through July 29, 2026.

item.title: Federal Reserve Board announces approval of application by National Westminster Bank Plc
item.description: The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced its approval of the application by National Westminster Bank Plc.

item.title: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with SouthPoint Bancshares, Inc. and announces termination of a previous action
item.description: The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday issued an enforcement action with SouthPoint Bancshares, Inc., and announced the termination of a previously announced action.
